events.title: ROADMAP
events.summary: Hello depot workers! The demo is out, and a lot of you have asked what comes next. Here is our roadmap: what's already in the game, what arrives with Early Access and what we plan to build after launch. Items are listed in the order we plan to work on them. Order and scope may change with your feedback, and nothing here is a promise of a date. events.title: Update: General Fixes and Improvements
events.summary: This one is mostly about how cargo feels in your hands. Thanks to everyone who sent feedback from the demo; a lot of this came straight from watching where people got stuck. Pallets, reworked E grabs and releases a pallet. While you haul one, both mouse buttons belong to the pallet: LMB always loads, RMB always unloads. No more dropping the pallet by accident. events.title: StowStow demo is live
events.summary: Hey! I've been building this warehouse game for a while and today you can finally play a piece of it.You're the guy at the loading dock. Trains bring boxes in, you scan them, slap the right labels on, stack what you can't ship yet, and get the rest onto the right truck before the day ends. Mess up a label and it shows on the receipt.The demo is the first three days. No saving, it just ends. That's on purpose.If you play it, tell me what annoyed you.
